title: SilentTech
description: Explore the Depths of your Minecraft World while also building up your base to be able to forge stronger Tools, Weapons, and Armor. This is a pack built around Silent Gear and Oritech
body:
A Kitchen Sink Pack built around Oritech AE2, and some other fun mods... With some things modified via KubeJS for balancing 

Key Mods
- Oritech
- Silent Gear
- AE2
- Create (w/ some addons)
- Computer Craft 
- and More
